questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. Speed advisory plaques on these signs show the recommended speed for the upcoming road condition.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for a side road intersecting the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic laws. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and look for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that wet pavement ahead will be slippery. Drive carefully and slowly in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. You will see it on one-way streets or if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Turning right here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you the signal is changing to red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is coming up. Pay attention to temporary traffic control devices as you drive through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, let all traffic and pedestrians cross, and then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are yellow or orange with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates traffic may be merging from the right. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If you see a pedestrian in a crosswalk, stop and stay stopped until they have completely crossed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you that you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to drive faster than an approaching train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.
